# cloudsmith_service_details (Data Source)

Retrieve detailed information about a single service account in a Cloudsmith organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "org" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

data "cloudsmith_service_details" "service" {
  organization = data.cloudsmith_organization.org.slug_perm
  service      = "example-service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization to which the service belongs.
- `service` (String) Slug of the service to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `created_by_url` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive)
- `key_expires_at` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `role` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `teams` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))
